Kai: Hi team, first day question: opening a tiny router fix + unit test. Quick checklist so I don't break norms?

Dana: Welcome! Branch: feature/<TICKET>-short. Commit format: area(scope): short summary. Keep PRs focused; if it's just logic+test, one PR is fine.

Kai: Any hard LOC limits?

Dana: Aim for under ~400 LOC of product code. Tests can add lines; call it out if large. Over 600 LOC requires justification.

ops-bot: Pre-commit hooks: black, isort, mypy. CI blocks merges on failures. Run `pre-commit run --all-files`. CI link: https://ci.redwood.example/job/1923456789

Kai: Who should I request for review?

Mira: Pick the CODEOWNER for the area + one peer. Add labels `area/runtime` and `needs-review`. If latency-sensitive add `needs-perf` and ping @Mira.

Kai: Rollback plan example?

Dana: Short bullets work. e.g. "Rollback: revert PR -> deploy -> run `tools/cachectl purge --prefix=router:`". Add perf metrics to watch if relevant.

Kai: Thanks! I'll push branch and paste PR link here when ready.
